text: The Codex Guidelines for the preservation of raw milk by the lactoperoxidase system (CAC/GL 13-1991) give the exact thiocyanate and peroxide doses; they were not opened here, so no numbers are given.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.name: catch
steps.note: The lactoperoxidase and lactoferrin are held by a resin at pH 6.2–6.6.

steps.name: release
steps.note: They are released by salt solution into a liquid about 500 times as concentrated, at about 1 % protein.
The protein is freeze-dried or spray-dried.

processing.text: The enzyme comes out together with lactoferrin, which is then separated from it.
